package serial

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

func TestPendingReadKeepsHandleUntilCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()

		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		readDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() {
			_, readErr := port.Read(make([]byte, 8))
			readDone <- readErr
		}()
		<-probeCalls.waitEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()

		probeCalls.Lock()
		prematureNativeClose := probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		cancelHandle := probeCalls.cancelHandle
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			prematureNativeClose = true
		default:
		}
		if prematureNativeClose {
			t.Error("Close returned or closed the native handle before pending Read completed")
		}
		if cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("CancelIoEx handle = %d; want %d while Read is pending", cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}

		close(probeCalls.release)
		synctest.Wait()
		err = <-readDone
		var portError *PortError
		if !errors.As(err, &portError) || portError.Code() != PortClosed {
			t.Errorf("Read error = %v; want PortClosed", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeCompletion {
			t.Error("native handle closed before pending Read completed")
		}
		if probeCalls.readHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.waitHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("handle contract: ReadFile=%d GetOverlappedResult=%d CancelIoEx=%d; want %d", probeCalls.readHandle, probeCalls.waitHandle, probeCalls.cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}
		if probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native port closes = %d; want 1", probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}

func TestPendingWriteKeepsHandleUntilCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() {
			_, writeErr := port.Write([]byte("W"))
			writeDone <- writeErr
		}()
		<-probeCalls.waitEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()

		probeCalls.Lock()
		closedEarly := probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		cancelHandle := probeCalls.cancelHandle
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			closedEarly = true
		default:
		}
		if closedEarly {
			t.Error("Close returned or closed the native handle before pending Write completed")
		}
		if cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("CancelIoEx handle = %d; want %d while Write is pending", cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}

		close(probeCalls.release)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err = <-writeDone; !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED) {
			t.Errorf("Write error = %v; want operation-aborted", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeCompletion {
			t.Error("native handle closed before pending Write completed")
		}
		if probeCalls.writeHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.waitHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("handle contract: WriteFile=%d GetOverlappedResult=%d CancelIoEx=%d; want %d", probeCalls.writeHandle, probeCalls.waitHandle, probeCalls.cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}
		if probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native port closes = %d; want 1", probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}

func TestSetModeKeepsHandleUntilConfigurationCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		probeHoldModeSet()
		modeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { modeDone <- port.SetMode(&Mode{BaudRate: 57600}) }()
		<-probeCalls.modeSetEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()

		probeCalls.Lock()
		closedEarly := probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		cancelHandle := probeCalls.cancelHandle
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			closedEarly = true
		default:
		}
		if closedEarly {
			t.Error("Close returned or closed the native handle before SetMode completed")
		}
		if cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("CancelIoEx handle = %d; want %d while SetMode is pending", cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}

		close(probeCalls.releaseModeSet)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err = <-modeDone; err != nil {
			t.Errorf("SetMode: %v", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeModeSet {
			t.Error("native handle closed before SetMode completed")
		}
		if probeCalls.modeGetHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.modeSetHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("handle contract: GetCommState=%d SetCommState=%d CancelIoEx=%d; want %d", probeCalls.modeGetHandle, probeCalls.modeSetHandle, probeCalls.cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}
		if probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native port closes = %d; want 1", probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}

func TestSetModeErrorClosesWithoutJoiningItself(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		probeFailModeSet()
		err = port.SetMode(&Mode{BaudRate: 57600})
		var portError *PortError
		if !errors.As(err, &portError) || portError.Code() != InvalidSerialPort {
			t.Errorf("SetMode error = %v; want InvalidSerialPort", err)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		if probeCalls.modeSetHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("SetCommState=%d CancelIoEx=%d; want %d", probeCalls.modeSetHandle, probeCalls.cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}
		if probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native port closes before explicit Close = %d; want 1", probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		if err = port.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close after SetMode failure: %v", err)
		}
	})
}

func TestSetDTRKeepsHandleUntilConfigurationCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		probeHoldModeSet()
		setDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { setDone <- port.SetDTR(true) }()
		<-probeCalls.modeSetEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()

		probeCalls.Lock()
		closedEarly := probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		cancelHandle := probeCalls.cancelHandle
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			closedEarly = true
		default:
		}
		if closedEarly {
			t.Error("Close returned or closed native handle before SetDTR completed")
		}
		if cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("CancelIoEx handle = %d; want %d", cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}

		close(probeCalls.releaseModeSet)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err = <-setDone; err != nil {
			t.Errorf("SetDTR: %v", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeModeSet {
			t.Error("native handle closed before SetDTR completed")
		}
		if probeCalls.modeGetHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.modeSetHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native contract: GetCommState=%d SetCommState=%d closes=%d", probeCalls.modeGetHandle, probeCalls.modeSetHandle, probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}

func testHeldControl(t *testing.T, call func(Port) error, flags uint32) {
	t.Helper()
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		probeHoldControl()
		callDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { callDone <- call(port) }()
		<-probeCalls.controlEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()

		probeCalls.Lock()
		closedEarly := probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		cancelHandle := probeCalls.cancelHandle
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			closedEarly = true
		default:
		}
		if closedEarly {
			t.Error("Close returned or closed native handle before control call completed")
		}
		if cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("CancelIoEx handle = %d; want %d", cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}

		close(probeCalls.releaseControl)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err = <-callDone; err != nil {
			t.Errorf("control call: %v", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeControl {
			t.Error("native handle closed before control call completed")
		}
		if probeCalls.controlHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.controlFlags != flags || probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native contract: handle=%d flags=%#x closes=%d", probeCalls.controlHandle, probeCalls.controlFlags, probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}

func TestResetInputBufferKeepsHandleUntilPurgeCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	testHeldControl(t, func(port Port) error { return port.ResetInputBuffer() }, windows.PURGE_RXCLEAR|windows.PURGE_RXABORT)
}

func TestResetOutputBufferKeepsHandleUntilPurgeCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	testHeldControl(t, func(port Port) error { return port.ResetOutputBuffer() }, windows.PURGE_TXCLEAR|windows.PURGE_TXABORT)
}

func TestGetModemStatusBitsKeepsHandleUntilQueryCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	var bits *ModemStatusBits
	testHeldControl(t, func(port Port) error {
		var err error
		bits, err = port.GetModemStatusBits()
		return err
	}, 0)
	if bits == nil || !bits.CTS || !bits.RI || bits.DCD || bits.DSR {
		t.Errorf("modem status = %+v; want CTS and RI only", bits)
	}
}

func TestDrainKeepsHandleUntilFlushCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	testHeldControl(t, func(port Port) error { return port.Drain() }, 0)
}

func TestSetReadTimeoutAfterCloseRejectsWithoutNativeCall(t *testing.T) {
	probeReset()
	port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
	}
	if err := port.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Close: %v", err)
	}
	probeCalls.Lock()
	before := probeCalls.timeoutSetCalls
	probeCalls.Unlock()

	err = port.SetReadTimeout(time.Second)
	var portError *PortError
	if !errors.As(err, &portError) || portError.Code() != PortClosed {
		t.Errorf("SetReadTimeout after Close = %v; want PortClosed", err)
	}
	probeCalls.Lock()
	defer probeCalls.Unlock()
	if probeCalls.timeoutSetCalls != before {
		t.Errorf("SetCommTimeouts called %d times after Close; want zero", probeCalls.timeoutSetCalls-before)
	}
}

func TestBreakKeepsHandleUntilClearCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		probeHoldBreak()
		const duration = 2 * time.Second
		breakDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { breakDone <- port.Break(duration) }()
		<-probeCalls.breakSetEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()

		probeCalls.Lock()
		closedEarly := probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		cancelHandle := probeCalls.cancelHandle
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			closedEarly = true
		default:
		}
		if closedEarly {
			t.Error("Close released native handle before SetCommBreak returned")
		}
		if cancelHandle != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("CancelIoEx handle = %d; want %d", cancelHandle, probePortHandle)
		}

		close(probeCalls.releaseBreakSet)
		<-probeCalls.breakClearEntered
		synctest.Wait()
		probeCalls.Lock()
		closedEarly = probeCalls.closeCount != 0
		elapsed := probeCalls.breakClearEnteredAt.Sub(probeCalls.breakSetReturnedAt)
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		if !closeReturned {
			select {
			case closeErr = <-closeDone:
				closeReturned = true
				closedEarly = true
			default:
			}
		}
		if closedEarly {
			t.Error("Close released native handle before ClearCommBreak completed")
		}
		if elapsed < duration {
			t.Errorf("Break duration before ClearCommBreak = %s; want at least %s", elapsed, duration)
		}

		close(probeCalls.releaseBreakClear)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err = <-breakDone; err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Break: %v", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeBreakClear {
			t.Error("native handle closed before ClearCommBreak completed")
		}
		if probeCalls.breakSetHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.breakClearHandle != probePortHandle || probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native contract: SetCommBreak=%d ClearCommBreak=%d closes=%d", probeCalls.breakSetHandle, probeCalls.breakClearHandle, probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}

func TestReadDoesNotRetryAfterCloseCancelsZeroCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		probeCalls.Lock()
		probeCalls.completionErr = nil
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Open: %v", err)
		}
		if err := port.SetReadTimeout(NoTimeout); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("SetReadTimeout: %v", err)
		}
		type readResult struct {
			n   int
			err error
		}
		readDone := make(chan readResult, 1)
		go func() {
			n, err := port.Read(make([]byte, 8))
			readDone <- readResult{n, err}
		}()
		<-probeCalls.waitEntered
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		<-probeCalls.cancelled
		close(probeCalls.release)
		result := <-readDone
		var portError *PortError
		if result.n != 0 || !errors.As(result.err, &portError) || portError.Code() != PortClosed {
			t.Errorf("Read = (%d, %v); want (0, PortClosed)", result.n, result.err)
		}
		if err := <-closeDone; err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", err)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		if probeCalls.readCalls != 1 {
			t.Errorf("ReadFile calls = %d; want 1", probeCalls.readCalls)
		}
		if probeCalls.closeCount != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native port closes = %d; want 1", probeCalls.closeCount)
		}
	})
}
